message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded datasets before use; preprocessing.scale is called but it is not a validation control.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from sklearn's built-in datasets or local files; no remote sources are used, so no checksum or authentication checks are needed or present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code applies only standard scaling and train/test splitting with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models; models are trained from scratch each run, so no integrity verification is performed or needed.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection of any kind.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library or mechanism (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD, noise injection) is used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: The code contains no adversarial attack generation or robustness testing libraries (e.g., Foolbox, ART, FGSM/PGD); evaluation is limited to standard SVM/KNN accuracy metrics.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, the cost function (cal_cost_svm/knn) is evaluated on training data during optimization, there is no cryptographic signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no multiple independent evaluation pipelines are used to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code applies preprocessing.scale and a bounds clamp on salp positions, but there is no shape/range validation or schema check on incoming inference inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and accuracy scores are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on the outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses SVM/KNN classifiers on tabular data, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
